title: FINNY Teams Up With Integrated Advisors Network
summary: FINNY is working with Integrated Advisors Network to give advisors in the network access to its AI-powered growth tools.
body_markdown:
FINNY is working with[Integrated Advisors Network](https://integratedadvisorsnetwork.com/) to give advisors in the network access to FINNY's AI-powered organic growth tools.


Integrated Advisors Network helps advisors grow their practices while saving time along the way. That's the same problem FINNY was built to solve, which makes working together a natural fit.


## What it means for Integrated's advisors


FINNY is an AI Chief Growth Officer purpose-built for financial advisors. Integrated's advisors now have access to a tool designed to help them grow without spending valuable time searching for and researching prospects on their own, while they stay in control of their message and their client relationships.


> “Advisors don’t need one more tool to manage. They need a growth partner that does the work for them. Bringing FINNY to Integrated Advisors Network means more advisors get exactly that.”
>
>
> — Eden Ovadia, Co-founder and CEO, FINNY


## Looking ahead


We're delighted to be working with Linda Pix, Michael A. Young and the rest of the Integrated Advisors Network team, and we look forward to playing our part in helping advisors in the network grow.
